name: GEF Small Grants Programme
summary: Global GEF programme that funds community-based and non-governmental organisations working on biodiversity, land degradation, climate and other environmental issues. Applicants go through the SGP country programme in their own country, which issues the calls.
reporting: Grants are paid in instalments: the mid-term payment follows a satisfactory progress report and the final payment follows a satisfactory project completion and final report.

applicant_types.quote: SGP grants are made directly to community-based organizations (CBOs) and non-governmental organizations (NGOs)

geography.quote: Are you an NGO/CBO in an SGP participating country?

access.quote: The project proponent- a national CBO or NGO- submits its application in response to a Call for Concepts/Proposals issued by the national SGP Country Programme.

amount.quote: The maximum grant amount per regular grant is US$75,000, but grants usually typically range from US$25,000 to US$50,000.

reporting.quote: a mid-term payment upon receipt of a satisfactory progress report; and a final payment on receipt of a satisfactory project completion and final report.
